# path_along_arc

Nguồn: [manim.utils.paths.path_along_arc](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.utils.paths.html#manim.utils.paths.path_along_arc)

path\_along\_arc(*arc\_angle*, *axis=array([0., 0., 1.])*)
:   This function transforms each point by moving it along a circular arc.

    Parameters:
    :   - **arc\_angle** (*float*) – The angle each point traverses around a circular arc.
        - **axis** ([*Vector3DLike*](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.typing.html#manim.typing.Vector3DLike "manim.typing.Vector3DLike")) – The axis of rotation.

    Return type:
    :   [*PathFuncType*](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.typing.html#manim.typing.PathFuncType "manim.typing.PathFuncType")

    Examples

    Example: PathAlongArcExample

    [Video example](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/PathAlongArcExample-1.mp4)

    ```
    from manim import *

    class PathAlongArcExample(Scene):
        def construct(self):
            colors = [RED, GREEN, BLUE]

            starting_points = VGroup(
                *[
                    Dot(LEFT + pos, color=color)
                    for pos, color in zip([UP, DOWN, LEFT], colors)
                ]
            )

            finish_points = VGroup(
                *[
                    Dot(RIGHT + pos, color=color)
                    for pos, color in zip([ORIGIN, UP, DOWN], colors)
                ]
            )

            self.add(starting_points)
            self.add(finish_points)
            for dot in starting_points:
                self.add(TracedPath(dot.get_center, stroke_color=dot.get_color()))

            self.wait()
            self.play(
                Transform(
                    starting_points,
                    finish_points,
                    path_func=utils.paths.path_along_arc(TAU * 2 / 3),
                    run_time=3,
                )
            )
            self.wait()
    ```
